# Start the ADX implementation

Open the existing ADX repository in Codex or Claude Code. Keep the attached specification and task manifest under `docs/build/`. Give the coding agent this request:

> Implement ADX using `docs/build/ADX_AUTONOMOUS_BUILD.md` as the seven-phase build specification and `docs/build/tasks.json` as the task graph. Follow AGENTS.md. Start by inspecting the actual working tree and existing implementations; preserve ongoing changes and reuse the current design, core, providers and tests. Build the earliest ready task, verify it, update durable progress/decisions/verification files, and continue through phases 0–6. Do not stop at another plan or at the pilot. Use fake providers for isolated tests, and keep real account mutations/calls disabled until the required access and business policy are supplied. Ask focused questions only for decisions that actually block dependent work, while continuing independent tasks. Distinguish local implementation from live-provider verification. Do not deploy, spend, contact customers, overwrite credentials or publish tickets without applicable authorization. If a required input is missing, record the exact blocked capability and what unblocks it; do not replace it with demo behavior and call it finished.

The master Markdown includes the task cards, contracts and acceptance journeys, so it can be supplied as a single attachment. The manifest helps an agent track dependencies. Existing code must be available in the coding workspace; the specification cannot replace private source, credentials or provider access.
